overview_description.description: Retake is a Dubai-based recommerce and sustainable electronics company focused on reducing electronic waste through a circular technology ecosystem. The platform offers refurbished smartphones, laptops, tablets, MacBooks, and other consumer electronics at affordable prices, along with services such as device trade-ins, repairs, recycling, rentals, and e-waste management. Retake aims to make technology more accessible and environmentally responsible by extending the lifecycle of electronic devices and encouraging sustainable consumption habits among consumers and businesses. The company also provides doorstep pickup, repair, and resale services, helping users conveniently manage their old electronics while contributing to a greener digital economy.
